newsitem.title: USA: CME board moves toward new pork belly contract.
newsitem.headline: CME board moves toward new pork belly contract.

text.p: The Board of Directors of the Chicago Mercantile Exchange, CME, approved a proposal to replace the current physically-delivered Frozen Pork Bellies Futures Contract with a Fresh Pork Bellies Futures Contract that will be cash-settled, according to a CME newsletter.
The contract specificaton for the new contract and the related options contract will be presented at the next Board meeting on December 4, 1996, the letter said.
Any changes to the contract would then require Commodity Futures Trading Commission approval.
